point: An indirect answer: no one needs to cover.
間接回答：根本不需要人代。
why: The question asks who will cover for Daniel. Their offices are closed that whole week anyway means the client is closed, so nobody has to cover.
問 Daniel 不在時誰接手。回答 Their offices are closed that whole week anyway，表示客戶那週休息，不需要人代。

gloss.ex: Can you cover my shift on Friday?
She manages three large accounts.
The store is closed on Monday anyway.

point: A request answered indirectly: someone else will do it.
請求句的間接回答：會有別人來做。
why: He asks her to mail the lease before you leave. His assistant is coming by to pick it up at noon means no mailing is needed.
問句要她出發前寄租約。回答 His assistant is coming by to pick it up at noon，表示不必寄了。

gloss.ex: We signed a one-year lease on the office.
The landlord will repair the heater.
Please come by my office after lunch.

point: A statement: the reply offers a way to fix the problem.
敘述句：回應主動提出解決辦法。
why: still haven't arrived states a problem. Should I give the sign company a call? offers to chase the late banners.
說布條 still haven't arrived 是個問題。回答 Should I give the sign company a call? 是提議去催布條。

gloss.ex: The banner hangs above the main entrance.
Our open house starts at ten.
Please hang the poster by the door.

point: A choice question: the answer can be "not decided yet."
選擇疑問句：回答可以是「還不能決定」。
why: The question asks cafeteria or restaurant now that the budget's been cut. Finance hasn't told us how much we can spend yet means the choice cannot be made yet.
問句要在員工餐廳或餐廳二選一。回答 Finance hasn't told us how much we can spend yet，表示現在還無法決定。

gloss.ex: Her retirement party is next Friday.
We eat lunch in the cafeteria.
The budget for travel was reduced.

point: How long asks for a length of time.
How long 問的是一段時間長度。
why: The question asks how long the network will be down. Probably most of Saturday gives the length of the shutdown.
問網路要停多久。回答 Probably most of Saturday，直接給出停機的長度。

gloss.ex: The office network is very slow today.
The upgrade will take two days.
The system will be down for an hour.

point: A problem question: listen to the first lines.
問題題：聽開頭幾句。
why: The woman opens with customer complaints were about late deliveries. That means customers are waiting too long for their orders.
女方開頭說 customer complaints were about late deliveries，也就是顧客等貨等太久。

point: Find who "they" is, then what Colin says.
先找出 they 指誰，再看 Colin 說什麼。
why: The woman asks about a second delivery company. Colin says they'd charge more per delivery than we actually make on the sale, so the store would lose money on many orders.
女方問第二家送貨公司。Colin 說 they'd charge more per delivery than we actually make on the sale，所以很多訂單會賠錢。

point: Choose the final decision.
選最後定案的內容。
why: Pickup at the warehouse is suggested, but The loading dock is closed to the public on weekends. The woman then decides weekdays only, which means Monday through Friday.
有人提議到倉庫自取，但 The loading dock is closed to the public on weekends。女方最後定案 weekdays only，就是週一到週五。

gloss.ex: We will look into the delay today.
They charge a fee for rush orders.
The hotel is fully booked this weekend.
Trucks park at the loading dock.
The showroom opens at nine.

point: A reason question: the reason comes right after.
原因題：理由緊接在後。
why: She says she wants to avoid air services, then adds My manager wants us to keep shipping costs to a minimum. Her supervisor wants expenses limited.
她說想避開空運，接著說 My manager wants us to keep shipping costs to a minimum，也就是主管要她壓低開支。

point: A graphic question: cross out what does not fit.
圖表題：先刪掉不符合的選項。
why: Standard is ruled out. ground shipments are running a day behind, so Express Ground would miss Thursday. She wants air but not overnight: the Two-Day Air row, $45.00.
標準件已排除。ground shipments 都 running a day behind，Express Ground 會趕不上星期四。她要空運但 not overnight，所以是 Two-Day Air 那一列，$45.00。

point: Listen for the man's own "I'll" sentence.
聽男方自己說 I'll 的那一句。
why: The man says I'll e-mail you a tracking number. A tracking number gives her a way to follow the shipment.
男方說 I'll e-mail you a tracking number。追蹤號碼讓她可以追蹤包裹。

gloss.ex: We can rule out the cheaper supplier.

gloss.w: keep shipping costs to a minimum
gloss.ex: Please keep costs to a minimum this quarter.
Trains are running behind schedule today.
I sent you the tracking number by e-mail.
Please forward the invoice to accounting.

point: A speaker question: infer the job from what she does.
身分題：從她做的事推測職業。
why: She says welcome to Hollis Glassworks and I'll be showing you around. A person who leads visitors through a workplace is a tour guide.
她說 welcome to Hollis Glassworks 和 I'll be showing you around。帶訪客參觀工作場所的人就是導覽員。

point: A quoted-line question: use the place named just before.
引句題：看前面剛提到的地點。
why: She has just said they begin in the furnace room. you won't need your jackets in there because a furnace room is very hot. She is warning about high temperatures.
她剛說先去 the furnace room。You won't need your jackets in there 是因為熔爐室很熱，她是在提醒溫度很高。

point: Listen for "except," then the reason after it.
聽 except，再聽後面的理由。
why: anywhere except the studio shows photos are not allowed there. The reason: the pieces won't be in stores until next spring, so it holds products not on sale yet.
anywhere except the studio 表示工作室不能拍照。理由是作品 won't be in stores until next spring，所以裡面有還沒上市的商品。

gloss.ex: The glassblower made a blue vase.
The furnace room is very hot.
I will show you around the office.
Feel free to ask me any questions.
Please stop by my desk later.
